items.title: Route `/settings/notifications` renders NotificationCenter
acceptance: GIVEN an authenticated user with a selected project
WHEN the browser navigates to a URL matching /settings/notifications
THEN the notification center screen is displayed at that URL
AND the location, parameters and history behave exactly as in the baseline application

items.title: Endpoint GET /notifications/notifications/prompt_lib/{projectId} (notificationList)
acceptance: GIVEN the user performs the notification list operation
WHEN the client issues the request
THEN it targets GET /notifications/notifications/prompt_lib/{projectId} with the same parameters, body shape and semantics as the baseline
AND the response payload drives the same visible data as in the baseline, with error responses surfaced as an error state instead of a blank screen

items.title: Endpoint PUT /notifications/notification/prompt_lib/{projectId}/{id} (notificationRead)
acceptance: GIVEN the user performs the notification read operation
WHEN the client issues the request
THEN it targets PUT /notifications/notification/prompt_lib/{projectId}/{id} with the same parameters, body shape and semantics as the baseline
AND on success the affected lists and detail views reflect the change without a manual refresh, while failures surface an error state

items.title: Socket event `notifications_notify` (catalogued)
acceptance: GIVEN an active socket connection on a screen that consumes notifications_notify
WHEN the server emits notifications_notify
THEN the visible state updates accordingly without a refetch
AND a malformed payload is logged and ignored rather than crashing the client

items.title: Action on notifications: notification bulk delete via onDeleteSelected
acceptance: GIVEN the notifications screen is displayed with the relevant entity available
WHEN the user activates the control wired to notification bulk delete
THEN a DELETE request to /notifications/notifications/prompt_lib/{projectId} is dispatched
AND the visible outcome matches the baseline: success updates the view, failure surfaces an error without losing user input

items.title: Copy: NotificationCenter/NotificationTable.jsx (4 strings)
acceptance: GIVEN the notifications screen renders with the default brand in both colour schemes
WHEN its user-visible texts are compared with the baseline application
THEN all 4 strings from this component (for example "Type") appear verbatim
AND no string is dropped, truncated or reworded
